verdict.rationale: Ironclad's API covers many core actions (records, workflows, launching workflows, webhooks, data exports, clickwrap embedding, template IDs) showing broad but not full parity with the UI. However, workflow authoring/design explicitly requires the UI 'Workflow Designer' (admin access, published there before API can launch it), and contract creation is framed as a 'No-Code Builder' UI feature, indicating key configuration/authoring tasks are UI-only. No OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows 404s), making it hard to verify complete API-UI parity. Missing for 10: evidence that workflow design/authoring and no-code contract creation can be done via API, and a published OpenAPI/full endpoint spec confirming total feature parity.
